'''2007 Massachusetts State Championship Jon Hollingsworth DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jon Hollingsworth]] at [[2007 Massachusetts State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jon Hollingworth (first name unclear: Jon/Jay/Tom)
* '''Deck name:''' I hope I don't play Hyperclone
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
